title: Rabbi Acha bar Chisda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Otzar Yisrael, under “Amoraim,” cites him at [Bava Batra 36b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.36b.2). Hyman says this is mistaken: Rav Chisda there says, “It is Rabbi Acha's view,” referring to Rabbi Acha the Tanna.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Bava Batra 36b explicitly has Rav Chisda identifying Rabbi Acha’s opinion in a baraita. Hyman argues that this attribution was wrongly read as a patronymic.
In the linked passage Rav Chisda attributes a view to Rabbi Acha. Hyman argues that Otzar Yisrael mistook that attribution for the patronymic Acha bar Chisda.
